{{Quote|But my master finally found and freed me, prudently paying what the Jawas asked.|QT-3PO|<ref name="Life">{{WEGCite|story=Life in a Jawa Sandcrawler|book=The Star Wars Sourcebook|reprint=1}}</ref>}}
'''QT-3PO's master''' was a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who owned a [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. While setting down for repairs in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[QT-3PO]] was abducted by [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] master found the [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]] that QT-3PO was in, and rescued the droid by paying the sum the Jawas wanted.<ref name="Life" />
